profile.summary: Elite Environmental Consulting is an industrial hygiene firm. It inspects and tests properties for hazards such as asbestos, lead-based paint, mold, bacteria and heavy metals. It also investigates indoor air quality and advises on regulatory compliance for commercial, residential, industrial, educational and government properties.
